narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>A cuboid has twelve edges, four in each direction, so the edges use twenty four units.
<bookmark mark='hidden'/>Three edges meet at a back corner that you cannot see.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Hidden edges are not drawn, so they use no line.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows 4 + 8 + 12 = 24; the hidden back corner and its three edges appear dashed, then fade; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='one'/>Three edges show in each direction.
<bookmark mark='two'/>Multiply each length by three, then add the three results.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. A cuboid is two units long, three deep and four tall. How many units of line does it use?
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the pencil box; two lines appear: three visible edges in each direction; multiply each length by three and add; then a new cuboid 2 long, 3 deep, 4 tall with an empty box
